The exact aspect ratio, as noted elsewhere in this paper, shifted from 2.66:1 (in early 1953 when Fox demonstrated the process using a dual system) to 2.55:1 (in late 1953 when the image and the four magnetic tracks were placed on a single piece of 35mm film) and, finally to 2.35:1 (in 1956 when the Magoptical system was introduced).
